items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: on drums with me... Chani was a whopping good little drummer then... I said, Chani, we're going up to Audubon to play tonight

ctx.x: I'd really have the six myself.

I ain't that little boy what you hear I'm talking about now, on drums with me. He was tying it up then. Chani. Chani was a whopping good little drummer then. That boy could play some drum. But he just was always wild, you know. But he always listened to me. He got bad after I left, you know, after I cut out and left, then he turned out bad, you know. But I could tell him, I said, Chani, we're going up to Audubon to play tonight or something like that. I said, we're not going up there drinking. We're going to go…
Now, in Chicago you named several fellas that used to sit in with you, white guys. Do you remember Muggsy Spaniel? Oh sure.
